The **abstraction package** is `internal/idp` (defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo` struct at `internal/idp/idp.go:3-8`).

The **implementation package** is `internal/idp/oauth2` (provides the concrete `IdentityProvider` struct implementing OAuth2 at `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go:20-22`).

The abstraction defines the user info contract that any provider must return (`Identifier`, `DisplayName`, `Email`, `AvatarURL`). The OAuth2 package realizes this by implementing token exchange and user info retrieval against an OAuth2-compliant endpoint, mapping claims to the abstract user info structure (lines 105–141 in oauth2.go).
